scripts.build:debug: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bun scripts/generate-plugin-registry.ts && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist --target=browser --sourcemap=external && bun scripts/copy-user-config.ts dist && bun scripts/build-user-plugin.ts dist && cp ./manifest.json ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css ./dist/ && cp -r ./icons ./dist/
scripts.build:release: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bun scripts/generate-plugin-registry.ts && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist --target=browser --production --sourcemap=external && bun scripts/copy-user-config.ts dist && bun scripts/build-user-plugin.ts dist && cp ./manifest.json ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css ./dist/ && cp -r ./icons ./dist/
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && bun scripts/generate-plugin-registry.ts && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist-firefox --target=browser --sourcemap=external && bun scripts/copy-user-config.ts dist-firefox && bun scripts/build-user-plugin.ts dist-firefox && cp ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css dist-firefox/ && cp ./manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r ./icons ./dist-firefox/
scripts.build:firefox:release: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && bun scripts/generate-plugin-registry.ts && bun build src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --outdir=dist-firefox --target=browser --production --sourcemap=external && bun scripts/copy-user-config.ts dist-firefox && bun scripts/build-user-plugin.ts dist-firefox && cp ./style.css ./popup.html ./popup.css dist-firefox/ && cp ./manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r ./icons ./dist-firefox/
scripts.version:inject: V=$(git describe --tags 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//') && [ -n "$V" ] && sed -i "s/\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"/\"version\": \"$V\"/" dist/manifest.json || echo 'No git tag found, using default version'
scripts.version:inject:firefox: V=$(git describe --tags 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//') && [ -n "$V" ] && sed -i "s/\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"/\"version\": \"$V\"/" dist-firefox/manifest.json || echo 'No git tag found, using default version'
scripts.release: bun run build:release && bun run version:inject && (cd dist && rm -f *.map && V=$(git describe --tags 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//') && zip -r ../vifhint-${V:-0.0.0}.zip .)
scripts.release:firefox: bun run build:firefox:release && bun run version:inject:firefox && (cd dist-firefox && rm -f *.map && V=$(git describe --tags 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//') && zip -r ../vifhint-firefox-${V:-0.0.0}.zip .)
scripts.fix:staged: sh -c 'FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|jsonc)$" || true); test -n "$FILES" && echo "$FILES" | xargs biome check --write && echo "$FILES" | xargs biome format --write && echo "$FILES" | xargs git add || true'
scripts.check:staged: sh -c 'FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|jsonc)$" || true); test -n "$FILES" && echo "$FILES" | xargs biome check || true'
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build
